title: More granular role/model assignments
decision: Keep the original seven roles and add implementer-fast, implementer-deep, simplifier, reviewer-second, and auditor. The exact names are a concrete design choice implementing the approved finer-grained control.

title: Keep the approved consolidations

title: Separate ideation from architecture
decision: ideate has its own pipeline. design still considers alternatives as part of shaping an architecture.

title: Offer an explicit rethink of an existing system
decision: Include alternatives as a standalone report-only entry point because the user raised it as potentially useful. Do not make it a mandatory phase or imply they demanded a redesign of every system.

title: Keep a reusable arena/swarm operation
decision: One model-invokable swarm skill supports manual invocation and composition, with distinct partition and compare modes.
source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

title: Default to structural improvement
decision: Permit and prefer a coherent root-cause refactor or redesign over a smaller patch when it better fulfills the same requirements. A substantive change gets a simplification assessment and fresh review, including reassessment after material iteration churn.
source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

title: Experiment with a from-scratch PR rewrite
decision: rewrite freezes the original, reconstructs semantic and operational goals, builds from the target base in a fresh context/worktree, independently compares and verifies, and preserves the original. It is never auto-invoked. One rewrite is the starting experiment, not a compulsory two-or-three-draft ritual.
source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

title: Complete implementation through merge-ready
decision: Starting delivery carries through implementation, structural improvement, review/fix, pushes/PR, CI and feedback, and final audit. Stop at merge-ready, never merge or arm auto-merge by default. Explicit narrower endpoints still apply.
source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

title: Keep one log and publish a confidence-graded decision audit
decision: Single canonical log with one writer, separate worktrees for simultaneous agents, independent evidence audit, and a durable artifact on the PR. TSV columns and repository-hosted publication are proposed concrete defaults, not claims of verbatim user instructions.
source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

title: Rename maintain to model-invokable compound
decision: Model invocation can inspect/propose learning. Apply a direct explicit instruction to change a skill/rule without another approval; inferred persistent instruction edits wait for approval. learn stays focused on project knowledge.
source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026
